newsitem.title: USA: Yachting-Yachts begin final leg of global challenge.
newsitem.headline: Yachting-Yachts begin final leg of global challenge.

text.p: Fourteen identical million-dollar yachts left Boston on Sunday heading for Southampton, England on the final leg of the round-the-world BT/MCI global challenge.
Fire boats saluted the fleet of 65-foot (21-metre), 42-tonne vessels as a flotilla of smaller ships escorted them to the harbor's edge and the start line.
The steel-hulled yachts with volunteer crews began their sail around the world in the wrong direction -- against prevailing winds and currents -- last September from Southampton.

The boats have stopped at Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Wellington, New Zealand, Sydney, Australia, Cape Town, South Africa and Boston. They are expected to begin arriving back in Southampton in about eight days.
